description: Main source file for sensor data acquisition and display on the X-NUCLEO-IKS4A1 platform using Zephyr RTOS. It initializes sensors, sets configurations, fetches sensor data, and outputs readings periodically.

methods.name: lps22df_trigger_handler
methods.description: Handles trigger event for LPS22DF sensor, fetches data and increments trigger count.

methods.name: lis2mdl_trigger_handler
methods.description: Handles trigger event for LIS2MDL sensor, fetches data and increments trigger count.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_acc_trig_handler
methods.description: Handles trigger event for LSM6DSO16IS accelerometer, fetches data and increments trigger count.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_acc_trig_handler
methods.description: Handles trigger event for LSM6DSV16X accelerometer, fetches data and increments trigger count.

methods.name: lis2mdl_config
methods.description: Configures LIS2MDL sensor sampling frequency and trigger.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_config
methods.description: Configures LSM6DSO16IS sensor parameters including mode, sampling frequency, and full scale, and sets trigger.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_config
methods.description: Configures LSM6DSV16X sensor parameters including mode, sampling frequency, and full scale, and sets trigger.

methods.name: lps22df_config
methods.description: Configures LPS22DF sensor sampling frequency and trigger.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing sensors, fetching data in a loop, and displaying sensor readings.
